# **Visualising graphs with ggplot2 package**

*The simple graph has brought more information to the data analyst’s mind than any other device." --- John Tukey*

1. **GGPLOT**- A Grammar of Graphics!

2. The Language

**ggplot**(data = <DATA>) + \\
**GEOM_FUNCTION**(mapping = aes(<MAPPINGS>),\\
     stat = <STAT>, 
     position = <POSITION>
  ) +
**COORDINATE_FUNCTION**+
  **FACET_FUNCTION**

  
# Why use ggplot2?


- Automatic legends, colors, etc.
- Easy superposition, facetting, etc.
- Nice rendering (though I don't like the default grey theme).

- Store any ggplot2 object for modification or future recall. Super useful for packages.

- Lots of users (less bugs, more help on Stack Overflow).

- Lots of extensions.

- Nice saving option.

# Aesthetics

- Color
- Size
- Line type
- Opacity
- Shape

# Map data cell values to aesthetics

.center[`aes(color = class)`]

Visual Space | &nbsp; | Data Space
---|---|---
`color` | &nbsp; | `mpg$class`
.red[Red] | $\Leftrightarrow$ | 2 seater
.blue[Blue] | $\Leftrightarrow$ | pickup
... | $\Leftrightarrow$ | ...
.green[Green] | $\Leftrightarrow$ | midsize

-------------

# **A few common geoms**

Type | Geom
---|---
Bar graph | `geom_bar()  geom_col()`
Histogram | `geom_hist`
Scatter plot | `geom_point()`
Line graph | `geom_line()`
Box plot | `geom_boxplot()`
Density | `geom_density()  geom_violin()`
Heat map | `geom_heatmap()`
Mapping | `geom_sf()`
Regression line | `geom_smooth()`

(https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/index.html#section-layer-geoms)]

# Your Turn 1

Run the code on the slide to make a graph. Pay strict attention to spelling, capitalization, and parentheses!

```{r, fig.dim=c(6,4)}
ggplot(data = mpg) +geom_point(mapping = aes(x = displ, y = hwy))
```

#  MAPPINGS

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
mpg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(displ, hwy)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_ellipse(data = . %>% filter(class == "2seater"), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.3)
```
#Maping 2


```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=9}
mpg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(displ, hwy)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = class)) +
  stat_ellipse(data = . %>% filter(class == "2seater"))
```

# Global v local


```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
library(babynames)

p1= babynames %>% 
  filter(name == "John" & sex == "M" | 
           name == "Elizabeth" & sex == "F") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, prop)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = sex)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, shape = "cross") +
  geom_text(data = . %>% filter(year == 1965), aes(label = name),
            nudge_y = .009) +
  labs(title = "Name Popularity") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")  

```

-----------------

```{r plop1t}
p1
```


# Facet wrap


```{r echo=TRUE, fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
p2= mpg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(displ, hwy)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ class)  #<<
```

-------------------


```{r plop1t2}
p2
```


# Labels

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
mpg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(displ, hwy)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Automobile mileage",               #<<
       x = "Displacement", y = "Highway mpg",      #<<
       caption = "Source:  ggplot2::mpg")          #<<
```
